# TestFlight setup

`fastlane ios beta` builds the iPhone app with its Lock Screen widget, Watch app, and watch
complications, uploads it to TestFlight, and submits it for external testing on the
"Public Beta" link. (`README.md` here is regenerated by fastlane on every run.)

```sh
fastlane ios beta                      # external testing
fastlane ios beta internal_only:true   # internal testers only
fastlane ios beta build_only:true      # build, sign and verify the .ipa; no upload
fastlane ios beta_distribute           # submit the latest uploaded build, no rebuild
fastlane ios beta_link                 # print the public TestFlight link
```

The marketing version comes from `pubspec.yaml` (`version: 1.0.0+1`); the build number is the
next free number in TestFlight.

## Prerequisites

- The app exists in App Store Connect with bundle ID `com.dumblemon.simpleAzaan`
  (the API cannot create apps).
- Xcode is signed in to the developer account (Xcode > Settings > Accounts). The archive step
  uses automatic signing so Xcode registers App IDs and the App Group, which the App Store
  Connect API key cannot do. Export then signs with the Apple Distribution certificate.
- The API key is at `~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys/AuthKey_4CXZBFY8C3.p8`.
- `ios/Runner.xcodeproj` stays at `objectVersion = 60` (the lane checks this).

## Identifiers

| Target | Bundle ID |
| --- | --- |
| Runner (iPhone app) | `com.dumblemon.simpleAzaan` |
| LockScreenWidgetExtension | `com.dumblemon.simpleAzaan.LockScreenWidget` |
| SimpleAzaan Watch Watch App | `com.dumblemon.simpleAzaan.watchkitapp` |
| SimpleAzaanComplicationsExtension | `com.dumblemon.simpleAzaan.watchkitapp.SimpleAzaanComplications` |

Every embedded bundle's ID must start with its parent's ID, including the letter case. The App
Group is `group.com.dumblemon.SimpleAzaan`; it is registered with a capital S, and group names
are not subject to the prefix rule.
